name: parcae_functional_form_bakeoff
metric: average Huber loss (x1e-7) of per-curve fits, lower=better
verbatim_quote: the exponential decay form achieves the lowest Huber loss both in-distribution (2.3x better than the shifted power law) and under extrapolation (7.1x better)... omitting the irreducible floor increases error by over 40x
meaning: External replication of TW-4 discriminator: geometric-decay-with-floor (our T1 functional form) beats pure power law on 140M and 370M looped LMs trained/owned by UCSD+Together. Our own-curve replication stays in G-phase.
